item: Row 459 (R853): each article chart counts its own undated articles
summary: Keyword-index charts (Insights trend, corpus-algebra trend, analysis trend, Home and Insights trending cards) say how many of their own articles have no date of their own and are drawn at the collection date, with the count of those carrying a feed date; the price correlation says how many it leaves out. Counted under the chart's own filters and window; n read from idx_article_published_at alone; feed count only up to 2000 (else not counted); a failed read says not counted, never 0; no re-index, no version bump.
